notes.value:
At head of title: Standard novels. No. XXVIII., followed by an unattributed quotation about fiction.

Northanger Abbey has an additional engraved title page and frontispiece; steel engravings by William Greatbatch, after paintings by Ferdinand Pickering.

Each novel has a separate title page; pagination and register are continuous.

Rare Book copy: Original plum glazed cloth binding; black and gilt labels.

Rare Book copy: From the library of Lytton Strachey (1880-1932), with his bookplates.

Rare Book copy: From the library of Roger Senhouse (1899-1970), with his autographs.
